why: A (universes at 0; the two M-polyfold lemmas at .{0,0}) is the conjunction of eight theorems: three local sc-diffeomorphism lemmas (tangent-reducedness and 'f(a) ∈ ∂f(M) iff a ∈ ∂M'), the local step boundaryTheta_apply_of_isScDiffeoOn, (11.11) for an equivalence (push, pull) and (11.11) for a generalized isomorphism on the chosen representative (theorem_11_3_8_push/pull). Every one of the last five assumes HasIndependentTangentSums Θ (Theorem 9.2.1's independence), which BoundaryB does not. A ⇒ B fails for exactly this reason: boundaryTheta is read off tangentValue, a chosen local branching structure (Nonempty.some), so without independence the chosen structures at y and at the moved point are unrelated. The independence is Theorem 9.2.1, which the project proves only in special cases (Prop 9.1.12 stated, not proved). A_to_BoundaryB_ind proves BoundaryB from A once the independence is added, on every representative (pushTheta_homMk, theorem_10_3_10). A second, smaller gap: DegPreservedB asks for equality of the degeneracy indices d_M of sub-M-polyfolds, but A has only 'd_M ≥ 1 iff d_{f(M)} ≥ 1' for smooth submanifolds. Equality is Proposition 2.24 for the induced structures, true but not a project lemma. B ⇒ A is proved: 7, 8 from BoundaryB with d = rep f, and 5, 6 from BoundaryB on the diagram X ←id X →F Y, all without using the independence A grants. 1–4 are local lemmas, not consequences of B, and are re-proved outright (the project's proofs, copied, from non-item lemmas). effort_only means: B is believed true (the text's Theorem 9.2.1), but A ⇒ B needs Theorem 9.2.1 in general, real mathematics the project leaves as a hypothesis, not glue.
